title: Yak-25RD Mandrake at Gagarin Military Academy Museum and U-2 in black paint scheme
description: Three black-and-white photographs. The caption reads "YAK-25RD Mandrake on display at the Gagarin Military Academy Museum (top and middle) U-2 in the new black paint scheme (left)." The top image shows the long-winged Soviet reconnaissance aircraft head-on with a red star visible, the middle shows its tail and fuselage, and the lower image shows a dark U-2 in flight over mountainous terrain.
